title: One-bit $(2,q)$-hypercontractivity
statement:
Fix a real exponent $q \ge 2$, and let $g : \{0,1\} \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function of arity one. Write $\norm{h}_p = \left(\E\,|h|^{p}\right)^{1/p}$ for the $L^p$ norm taken with respect to the uniform measure, and let $T_\rho$ denote the noise operator. Then, with noise parameter $\rho = 1/\sqrt{q-1}$,
\[
  \norm{T_{1/\sqrt{q-1}}\, g}_q \;\le\; \norm{g}_2 .
\]
hypotheses_covered: g is a Boolean function of arity one (on the single-bit cube)
left norm is the L^q norm, right norm is the L^2 norm, both under the uniform measure
